sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Earth Release, Fire Release

system.description:
Select one point you can see within a Molten Terrain you created as a fissure forms and releases a gout of noxious steam. All creatures within the affected area must make a Constitution saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures resists this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creatures are Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures gain 1 rank of Dazzled and are Dazed.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creatures is Envenomed instead of Dazzled.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the size of the radius by +5 feet.
